why: Cards with their own control or a global binding need one precedence rule and a middleware order that retains globals and strips defaults without losing deep links.
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/router/controls/{define,field,codec,brand}* except the two ctl-3 seam functions in define*
CHANGELOG.md, MIGRATING.md, llms.txt, scripts/check-budgets/**, other areas' migrations files
contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, this domain's contract.ts, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. Read concepts/controls-url-state.md sections 3, 5, 9, 10 and evidence/gap-global-local-control-scope.md section 3 (prototype API). Scope model table in section 3: widget state is URL key w.<id>.<field>, scalar kinds only (enum, string, number, boolean), at most 2 fields per widget by type, w. is a reserved prefix.
exemplar: evidence/gap-global-local-control-scope.md prototype tests (37, 7 precedence cases); flip ctl3-* in tests/controls/golden.
change: defineControls gains retain, widget and middlewares through the two seam functions in define*. widgets on a page store; useSource() returns own, inherited or override; a widget bound to a global (widgets: { latency: { range: globals.field.range } }) inherits, shows the effective value and writes only its own w. key; precedence override > inherited > fallback; an override equal to the global still pins. middlewares [strip, retain] in that order, retain for page stores via retain: keys on a layout route. useOverrides() returns {keys, widgets, clearAll}. A widget handle's isDefault means 'no override'. Rule: none (ctl-8 flags a raw control on a widget handle). Skill: generated docs/widgets.md (where-does-state-live table). Tests: the 7 precedence cases, history replace on widgets, no re-render of a header pill or sibling card (memo), SSR.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: bun test over src/router/controls with memory history, tsc on the type fixtures.
acceptance: 7 precedence cases pass, including deep link with override and global both set honours the override and rewrites nothing
a global handle used as a widget field and a multi or range widget field fail to type-check (@ts-expect-error fixtures)
a widget with 3 fields fails to type-check
clear() unsets a retained key (explicit undefined) and Reset overrides clears every w. key
SSR hydrate with an overridden widget: zero recoverable errors
all ctl3-* test.failing from ctl-1 are normal passing tests (or deleted with a reason in the PR body)
S8: retain on a layout route with six children keeps globals and strips defaults (router memory history)
git diff --name-only lists only owned paths
